FinFocus CLI and plugin host

## Synopsis

```text
FinFocus: Calculate projected and actual cloud costs via plugins.

With no subcommand, show overview for a detected Pulumi or Terraform project.
Terraform projections run OpenTofu plan and show without running init.
Projection commands accept --terraform-plan for saved show -json output and
--include-workspace for workspace-scoped Terraform history.
```

```text
finfocus [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # Calculate projected costs from a Pulumi plan
  finfocus cost projected --pulumi-json plan.json

  # Get actual costs for the last 7 days
  finfocus cost actual --pulumi-json plan.json --from 2025-01-07

  # Get cost recommendations with custom cache TTL (5 minutes)
  finfocus cost recommendations --pulumi-json plan.json --cache-ttl 300

  # Install a plugin from registry
  finfocus plugin install opencost

  # List installed plugins
  finfocus plugin list

  # Initialize a new plugin project
  finfocus plugin init aws-plugin --author "Your Name" --providers aws

  # Validate all plugins
  finfocus plugin validate

  # Initialize configuration
  finfocus config init

  # Set configuration values
  finfocus config set output.default_format json

  # Open the browser dashboard for the current Pulumi or Terraform project
  finfocus --web

  # Serve on a pinned port without opening a browser (for example over SSH)
  finfocus --web --port 8484 --no-browser

  # Use pre-exported files instead of running Pulumi CLI commands
  finfocus --web --pulumi-state state.json --pulumi-json plan.json

  # Open two stacks as tabs in one dashboard
  finfocus --web --stack dev,prod
```

## Options

```text
      --adapter string                      restrict to a specific adapter plugin (only valid with --web)
      --allowed-host stringArray            accept this public host name behind an HTTPS proxy on this machine, such as tailscale serve; repeatable, exact names only (only valid with --web)
      --allowed-user stringArray            tailnet login admitted by --trusted-proxy; repeatable (only valid with --web)
      --cache-ttl int                       cache TTL in seconds; when set, overrides FINFOCUS_CACHE_TTL and config (0 disables the cache)
      --debug[=true|false]                  enable debug logging
      --dry-run[=true|false]                emit the envelope without side effects
      --filter strings                      resource filters (only valid with --web)
      --format string                       output format: json or human
      --from string                         start date (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339; with --web, defaults to the first day of the current month) (only valid with --web or --import-cloud-history)
  -h, --help[=true|false]                   help for finfocus
      --idempotency-key string              opaque key used to prevent duplicate-create retries
      --import-cloud-history[=true|false]   import Pulumi Cloud historical resource identities without calculating costs
      --mcp[=true|false]                    serve finfocus as a Model Context Protocol server over stdio (alias for mcp-server)
      --no-browser[=true|false]             do not open a browser; print the web UI URL only (only valid with --web)
      --port int                            pin the web UI port (0 = kernel-assigned; only valid with --web)
      --project-dir string                  explicit Pulumi project directory for config resolution
      --pulumi-json string                  path to Pulumi preview JSON; state is still read from the detected project, if available, unless --pulumi-state is set (only valid with --web)
      --pulumi-state string                 path to Pulumi state JSON (only valid with --web)
      --skip-version-check[=true|false]     skip plugin spec version compatibility check
      --stack stringArray                   Pulumi stack name for auto-detection; with --web, comma-separated or repeated names open one tab per stack (only valid with --web or --import-cloud-history)
      --strict[=true|false]                 escalate warnings to a validation error
      --to string                           end date (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339, defaults to now) (only valid with --web or --import-cloud-history)
      --trusted-proxy[=true|false]          admit requests that carry an allowed Tailscale-User-Login without the session token; needs --allowed-host and --allowed-user (only valid with --web)
  -v, --version[=true|false]                version for finfocus
      --web[=true|false]                    serve the finfocus web UI on localhost and open it in a browser (Pulumi or Terraform projects)
      --yes[=true|false]                    confirm a confirmation-gated operation
```
